pages.title: Phial of Lotus Essence
pages.text: Grants water breathing, night vision, and dolphin's grace. Essential for exploring underwater areas.

pages.title: Elixir of Ra's Spark
pages.text: Provides fire resistance and strength. Use before facing fire-based enemies or traversing lava.

pages.title: Scarab Talisman
pages.text: Grants temporary protection and regeneration when activated. A reusable defensive item.
